findings.issue: Keydown auto-repeat (event.repeat) is not filtered, and reviewCard (useStudy.ts) / reviewVocab (useLanguage.ts) have no in-flight guard. A fast double press or a held key posts the same card_id twice before the queue refreshes, which means two reviews, 20 XP and two log entries for one card.
findings.fix: Return early on event.repeat in the hook, and keep a pending ref/flag in reviewCard/reviewVocab that ignores grade calls until the current request resolves.

findings.issue: Undo always targets last_active_review(). If that review's card was deleted (card_not_found) or changed (stale), every later undo returns 409 and no older review in that deck can ever be undone.
findings.fix: When the newest active review can't be undone, append a marker entry (e.g. {type:'undo_skipped', target}) that active_reviews() excludes, or let undo_last_review fall through to the next older review.

findings.issue: LanguageStore.undo_last_review restores the card but doesn't recompute stats.vocab_mastered. A review that crossed the mastered threshold stays counted after undo. TutorStore.undo_last_review does call _refresh_flashcard_stats().
findings.fix: Set stats['vocab_mastered'] = self._count_mastered() after restore(card, ...) and before _save().

findings.issue: tutor_add_flashcard ('Reversível: exclua o flashcard criado.') and language_add_weak_phoneme ('Reversível: remova o fonema da lista...') are marked reversible=True, but there is no flashcard delete and no weak-phoneme removal anywhere in the app. action_proposals.py shows this text to the user.
findings.fix: Set reversible=False with accurate 'Não reversível...' text for both, or add the missing delete/remove features.
